{{Quote|You feel that just now? Like a - a tremor, or something?|Nolan Pars|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Nolan Pars''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3642 BBY]], he asked a fellow Republic citizen to re-calibrate seismic
sensors at the [[Crescent Canyon Monitoring Station]] in the [[Whiterock Wastes]] that could warn him of an impending ice shelf collapse.
